comment: Written against Gemini CLI 2026 (Ink TUI). Gemini CLI was not available in the sandbox: screens were transcribed from documented UI text and must be re-verified against live sessions. The tool confirmation dialog ('Allow execution of: …?', 'Apply this change?', '● 1. Yes, allow once') is BLOCKED; the Braille spinner line ending in '(esc to cancel, <n>s)' is WORKING; the rounded input box with the 'Type your message or @path/to/file' placeholder is IDLE. The input box stays visible while Gemini works, so the idle rule vetoes on 'esc to cancel,' and has the lowest priority; the approval rule vetoes on it too and anchors its question patterns, because a tool-result box that echoes 'Do you want to proceed? n' must not read as a confirmation dialog. No rule depends on the alternate-screen flag.
